stemMd: A committee of two is selected from six people. Two particular people refuse to serve together. How many committees are allowed?
explanationMd: There are C(6,2)=15 unordered pairs. Only one pair contains both specified people, so subtract one to get fourteen. Each of those people may still serve with someone else.

distractorRationale.d: This counts all committees before excluding the forbidden pair.
distractorRationale.a: This excludes one specified person entirely, leaving C(5,2)=10; the rule excludes only the pair containing both specified people.
distractorRationale.e: This counts ordered selections and then removes too few duplicates.
distractorRationale.b: This excludes more than the single forbidden pair.
